title: External blocker attribution and callback reachability

definitions.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: progress.py: MUST_REACH_EXTERNAL_HELPER on allocator 0x00686000 (helper-cut). Not every protected-boundary caller.
definitions.DIRECT: Function itself calls root blocker (audit and/or verified map).
definitions.TRANSITIVE: Every returning ordinary path hits a MUST/direct callee of the root.
definitions.CALLBACK_REGISTRATION: DATA/store of callback address; not ordinary execution of the callback body.

summary.note: All 74 BLOCKED_EXTERNAL share root 0x00686000. No status reclassification: Ghidra call sites alone do not justify changing BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, and callback registration edges are not execution edges.

audit_vs_project.audit_completeness_issue: Allocator root claims complete:true but omits >=6 verified ordinary direct callers present in project function-map and .text.

0x00686030.label: free
0x00686030.note: Secondary direct edge; primary BLOCKED_EXTERNAL root remains allocator.

callback_registration_edges.label: window callback boundary / GameFrame lpfnWndProc-shaped store
callback_registration_edges.note: Address supplied into window-class preparation; not an ordinary direct call. Do not treat as executed WndProc without further evidence.

callback_registration_edges.label: render-thread callback boundary
callback_registration_edges.note: Callback address pushed before thread-wrapper call; registration edge only. Actual callback execution remains unmodeled as an ordinary call-graph edge.
